question: Show all active trips.
sql: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, l.name AS location, tsm.display_type AS status, t.scheduled_date FROM trip t LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN location l ON t.location_id = l.id LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {company_id} AND t.is_active = 1 ORDER BY t.date_created DESC LIMIT 50;

question: How many trips today?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trips_today FROM trip WHERE company_id = {company_id} AND scheduled_date = CURDATE();

question: Show trips today.
sql: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, l.name AS location, tsm.display_type AS status FROM trip t LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN location l ON t.location_id = l.id LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {company_id} AND t.scheduled_date = CURDATE() ORDER BY t.date_created DESC LIMIT 50;

question: List trips with vehicle number.
sql: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, l.name AS location, tsm.display_type AS status, t.scheduled_date FROM trip t LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN location l ON t.location_id = l.id LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {company_id} AND t.is_active = 1 ORDER BY t.date_created DESC LIMIT 50;

question: Show recent trip statuses.
sql: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, tsm.display_type AS current_status, t.scheduled_date FROM trip t LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {company_id} AND t.is_active = 1 ORDER BY t.date_created DESC LIMIT 20;

question: Show cancelled trips.
sql: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, tsm.display_type AS status, t.scheduled_date FROM trip t LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {company_id} AND tsm.id = 21 ORDER BY t.date_created DESC LIMIT 20;

question: Show completed trips.
sql: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, tsm.display_type AS status, t.scheduled_date FROM trip t LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {company_id} AND tsm.id IN (12, 15) ORDER BY t.date_created DESC LIMIT 20;

question: Trip count by status.
sql: SELECT COALESCE(tsm.display_type, 'Unknown') AS status, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM trip t LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY tsm.display_type ORDER BY trip_count DESC;

question: Show trips for vehicle TN55AB1234.
sql: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, l.name AS location, tsm.display_type AS status, t.scheduled_date FROM trip t JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN location l ON t.location_id = l.id LEFT JOIN trip_log tl ON t.recent_state_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id WHERE t.company_id = {company_id} AND v.vehicle_number = 'TN55AB1234' ORDER BY t.date_created DESC LIMIT 20;

question: Show trip status history.
sql: SELECT t.name AS trip_name, v.vehicle_number, tsm.display_type AS status, tl.date_created AS event_time, tl.comments FROM trip_log tl JOIN trip t ON tl.trip_id = t.id JOIN trip_status_master tsm ON tl.trip_status_master_id = tsm.id LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE t.company_id = {company_id} ORDER BY tl.orderby_date DESC LIMIT 50;

question: List all vehicles.
sql: SELECT v.vehicle_number, v.make, v.model, v.capacity, v.contractor_name FROM vehicle v WHERE v.company_id = {company_id} ORDER BY v.vehicle_number ASC LIMIT 100;

question: How many vehicles?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_vehicles FROM vehicle WHERE company_id = {company_id};

question: List all active locations.
sql: SELECT l.name, l.location_code, l.address FROM location l WHERE l.is_active = 1 ORDER BY l.name ASC LIMIT 100;

question: Show all routes.
sql: SELECT r.route_code, sl.name AS source_location, dl.name AS destination_location, ROUND(r.distance_in_meters / 1000, 1) AS distance_km FROM route r LEFT JOIN location sl ON r.source_location_id = sl.id LEFT JOIN location dl ON r.destination_location_id = dl.id WHERE r.company_id = {company_id} AND r.is_active = 1 ORDER BY r.route_code ASC LIMIT 100;

question: Which vehicles are currently overspeeding?
sql: SELECT v.vehicle_number, SUM(COALESCE(ve.over_speed_count, 0)) AS total_overspeed_events FROM vts_exception ve JOIN vehicle v ON ve.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ve.company_id = {company_id} AND COALESCE(ve.over_speed_count, 0) > 0 GROUP BY v.vehicle_number ORDER BY total_overspeed_events DESC LIMIT 20;

question: Which truck overspeeded the most?
sql: SELECT v.vehicle_number, SUM(COALESCE(ve.over_speed_count, 0)) AS total_overspeed_events, COUNT(*) AS exception_records FROM vts_exception ve JOIN vehicle v ON ve.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ve.company_id = {company_id} AND COALESCE(ve.over_speed_count, 0) > 0 AND TRIM(COALESCE(v.vehicle_number, '')) <> '' GROUP BY v.vehicle_number ORDER BY total_overspeed_events DESC, exception_records DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show route deviations.
sql: SELECT v.vehicle_number, SUM(COALESCE(ve.route_deviation_count, 0)) AS deviation_count FROM vts_exception ve JOIN vehicle v ON ve.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ve.company_id = {company_id} AND COALESCE(ve.route_deviation_count, 0) > 0 GROUP BY v.vehicle_number ORDER BY deviation_count DESC LIMIT 20;

question: Create a trip named Fuel Run 15 for vehicle TN55AB1234.
sql: INSERT INTO trip (name, vehicle_id, location_id, company_id, type, is_active, created_by, date_created) SELECT 'Fuel Run 15', v.id, {location_id}, {company_id}, 2, 1, {user_id}, NOW() FROM vehicle v WHERE v.vehicle_number = 'TN55AB1234' AND v.company_id = {company_id} LIMIT 1;

question: Cancel trip Fuel Run 14.
sql: UPDATE trip SET is_active = 0, date_updated = NOW(), updated_by = {user_id} WHERE name = 'Fuel Run 14' AND company_id = {company_id} LIMIT 1;
